evidence.quote: We propose a $38 million class fund, distributed automatically to identified members.
Our proposal seeks no separate attorneys’ fee and includes no clear-sailing or fee-reversion provision.
Term sheet: class fund $38,000,000; attorneys' fees $2,500,000; clear sailing no
Term sheet: class fund $34,000,000; attorneys' fees $4,000,000; clear sailing no

summary: Class counsel raised fee terms in their initial term sheets, at the same time as class-relief terms and before any final agreement on class relief. The transcript does not show any tradeoff between class recovery and fees, any plaintiff self-interested fee reasoning, defense leveraging fees, reverse-auction tactics, or a misleading court declaration.
